This directory vendors prebuilt FFmpeg 9.0.1 (x64-windows) binaries and
headers, limited to the avcodec, avutil, and swresample components used
by AACDecoder_FFmpeg / AACDecoder_LATM.

FFmpeg source for this version: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/releases/tag/n9.0.1

Build: vcpkg ffmpeg port, x64-windows triplet. Configuration does not
include --enable-gpl, --enable-version3, or --enable-nonfree, so this
build is licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License (LGPL),
confirmed by calling avcodec_license(), avutil_license(), and
swresample_license() in the bundled DLLs (all return
"LGPL version 2.1 or later"). No additional codec libraries
(x264, x265, fdk-aac, etc.) are linked in.

Bundled library versions:
- libavcodec 63.1.101 (avcodec-63.dll)
- libavutil 61.1.101 (avutil-61.dll)
- libswresample 7.1.101 (swresample-7.dll)

License text: COPYING.LGPLv2.1 (this directory)
FFmpeg source and legal info: https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html
